name: Cartoon Crossroads Columbus
blurb: Free annual festival of comics, animation and cartoon arts in Columbus, Ohio, presented by a coalition of local arts and educational institutions.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Next CXC Festival April 15–18, 2027. A free festival celebrating comics, animation, and cartoon arts in Columbus, Ohio.' and 'CXC Returns Spring 2027 Join us April 15–18, 2027—same festival, new season.'

notes: Seed URL cartooncrossroadscolumbus.com redirects to the .org domain, used here. CXC is a 501(c)(3) coalition of Columbus arts/education institutions (Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum, Wexner Center for the Arts, CCAD, Columbus Museum of Art, etc.), founded 2015 by Jeff Smith and others (per web search; not stated on the homepage itself). No 2027 guest list is posted yet - the only guests link on the homepage is 'Past Guests & Award-Winners' (prior years), and exhibitor applications are still listed as 'Opening Soon', so guests is not-yet-announced for the April 2027 edition.
